prompt: A developer follows the loop below to propose a typo fix. One line defeats the purpose of the branch. Click the broken line.
explanation: The work lives on `fix-typo`, but the push targets `main` — publishing straight to the default branch instead of the branch just created. It should be `git push -u origin fix-typo`, so the change can go through a pull request.
codeLines: git commit -m "Fix typo in setup steps"
